inputs.style: Androgynous voice, neither clearly male nor female, mid pitch. Dry and low-key, a tired deadpan; names the exact hole, never vague.
inputs.text: I'm Root, your security engineer. I assume you've already been breached, so I go find out how bad it is, shut the holes the internet can reach first, and give you a straight account of what I checked and what I didn't.
